    Trail SnacksBush damper with golden syrupRound oven-baked damper loaf, served with butter and golden syrupHow to make it60g butter, cold, for the dough450g self-raising flour1 pinch salt300ml milk50g butter, for serving4 tbsp golden syrupHeat the oven to 200°C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.Mix in the milk to a soft dough, shape into a round and score a cross.Bake until it sounds hollow when tapped.Serve warm with the butter for serving and golden syrup.Wally's Walkabout Creek snagsWalkabout Creek welcomes Mick home. Beef snags in white bread, fried onions, tomato sauce.How to make it8 thick beef sausages2 brown onions8 slices of white bread4 tbsp tomato sauce1 tbsp neutral oilSlice the onions.Grill the sausages slowly over medium heat, turning often, and fry the onions in oil until soft and golden at the same time.Wrap each sausage in a slice of bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.Kakadu plum salsaGrown on Belonga Mick, Mick's own patch. Kakadu plum or green mango, chilli, lime, corn chipsHow to make itNot on tonight's cookKakadu plum or green mango diced with chilli, lime, red onion and coriander, corn chips or grilled flatbread.Grilled yabbies with garlic butterBush tucker while Walter misleads Rico's men.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Mess Hall MainsDynamite-caught campfire barraWhole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in paperbark, cooked over coals.How to make it1.5kg whole barramundi, cleaned2 lemons1 knob ginger, sliced1 bunch coriander50g butterStuff the barramundi with lemon slices, sliced ginger and the coriander.Dot with butter and wrap well in foil.Cook over hot coals or a hot grill, turning once.Rest briefly before opening the parcel.Subway handoff steak sandwichRico wants the photos at the subway. Mick wants lunch. Rump on Turkish, beetroot, onion, cheddarHow to make itNot on tonight's cookRump seared hard and rested, sliced, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, melted cheddar, beetroot and barbecue sauce.Campfire TreatsI am home pavlovaCrisp meringue with whipped cream, passionfruit and sliced mangoHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour1 tsp white vinegar300ml thickened cream, whipped4 passionfruits1 mangoWhip the egg whites to soft peaks.Add the sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in the cornflour and vinegar.Pile onto a lined tray and shape into a round.Bake at 120°C.Turn the oven off and leave the pavlova to cool inside.Top with whipped cream, passionfruit and sliced mango.Canteen DrinksTop End lemon myrtle gin and tonicGin and tonic with a lemon myrtle sugar rim and a squeeze of limeHow to make it1 tbsp caster sugar1 tsp ground lemon myrtle4 limes1 tray ice180ml gin600ml tonic waterMix the sugar and lemon myrtle on a plate. Run a lime around each glass rim and dip.Fill the glasses with ice, add gin and lime juice.Top with tonic and add a lime wheel.Dark rum and colaBack in the bush, Walter pours.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
